international.title: Trump’s transportation secretary blames contractor for nationwide FAA ground stop – live
international.summary: US transportation secretary Sean Duffy blames contractor L3Harris for national ground stoppage and says ‘this was not identified quick enough’ Sign up for US breaking News email Linked to that, the White House held a briefing call with several reporters today about the wave of tech outages affecting several industries. CNN reported that officials said the administration underscored that what has happened is not as a result of cyber-attacks but due to the “hardening and upgrading of our systems ”, including “systems being patched, hardware being applied” . Per CNN, an official added: “It’s good the American people are focused on the need to upgrade our legacy systems.” Continue reading...
